game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket, a berry thicket: the beast tamer must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Volley Counter: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming bramble beasts.
theme: Mystic Forest – Berry Thicket: a berry thicket
core_gameplay_loop: In Berry Thicket, repeat each round: Fire a volley of shots with for shot in range(volley) at oncoming bramble beasts. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the ammo value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the heartwood tree using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The heartwood tree reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the heartwood tree is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Volley Counter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Volley Counter' (Week 5 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Berry Thicket'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how ammo changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bramble beasts in Berry Thicket.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The heartwood tree reached with actions_used <= 19.
